description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for verifying various 'git var' commands and related environment behaviors, primarily used for testing git's variable retrieval and configuration management.

methods.name: sane_unset_all_editors
methods.description: Unsets GIT_EDITOR, VISUAL, and EDITOR environment variables to ensure a clean environment for testing editor-related variables.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, possibly with environment setup and assertions.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command and asserts that it fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or strings to verify their contents are identical.

methods.name: test_tool path-utils normalize_path_copy
methods.description: Normalizes a filesystem path, ensuring consistency across environments.

methods.name: test_path_is_executable
methods.description: Checks if a given path points to an executable file.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a command's output or a string is empty.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific exit code.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Verifies the presence of prerequisites or environment conditions before running certain tests.
